description: Implementation of the ReuseAllocatorBase class for memory management, including allocation, freeing, and internal block merging logic.

classes.name: ReuseAllocatorBase
classes.description: A memory allocator class that manages free and allocated memory blocks, supporting allocation, deallocation, and internal block merging.

classes.name: MemoryBlock
classes.description: Represents a block of memory with methods for merging, checking fulfillment, and allocation within the block.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges this memory block with another if they are contiguous.

methods.name: CanFulfill
methods.description: Checks if the memory block can fulfill a request of a given size and alignment.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates a sub-block within this memory block with specified size and alignment, optionally from the front.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates memory with specified size and alignment, returning a pointer.

methods.name: Free
methods.description: Frees a previously allocated memory block.

methods.name: PrintAllocations
methods.description: Prints current allocations and free blocks statistics.

methods.name: TryFree
methods.description: Attempts to free a memory block, returning success status.

methods.name: ExpandToFit
methods.description: Expands the allocator capacity to fit a requested size and alignment.

methods.name: AddFreeBlock
methods.description: Adds a free block, merging with adjacent blocks if possible.

methods.name: RemoveFreeBlock
methods.description: Removes a free block from the free list.
